title: Halve until small
prompt: Keep dividing n by 2 with whole-number division until it is less than 10, and return how many divisions that took. 100 takes 4: 50, 25, 12, 6.
hints: `while n >= 10:` divide, and add one to a counter.

docs.name: while condition:
docs.what: Repeats the indented lines below it as long as the condition stays true.
